drafted_from: workflow:make-a-brand-book-and-decks's own row (its words, input schema, sample run and steps); read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:make-a-brand-book-and-decks." Make a brand book that shows every settled brand decision with its source, a pitch deck and a sales deck in that brand, and a copy of each deck for each buyer where only the buyer's own facts change, every claim and price read from the person's own records
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Run workflow:make-a-brand-book-and-decks" with the input in the worked example.

2. The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run (row workflow:make-a-brand-book-and-decks) and works through its steps in order: brand, look, decisions, claims, brand-book, decks, per-buyer, check-public-copy, approve.
3. Read what each step hands back; the last step is approve.

worked_examples.title: Make a brand book and decks from its first step

input.brand_list: <brand_list: The id of the person's brand list (one row per logo variant and one selection row)>
input.look: <look: The look the brand wears: its record id, or a file holding the look record>
input.claims: <claims: Where the person's verified claims are kept (a list or a file): each claim's exact words, its source and whether it is verified>
input.price: <price: The record or file that holds the price the decks quote>
input.out: <out: The folder on the person's computer the PDFs and pictures go into>
input.copy_check: <copy_check: The person's own command that checks the public words of a folder of documents and exits 0 only when they pass, with {out} where the folder goes>

worked_examples.hands_back: Step brand answers with family, light, dark, missing.
worked_examples.given: The person gives: brand_list, look, family, file, claims, price, out, copy_check (shown as <name> in the input).
